summary: Tested 215bw brand isolation fixes. CRITICAL: PulseLandingPage.js uses GymAxis cyan (#19CDFF) instead of Pulse blue (#66ccff) for 79 elements including LOG IN button. Cookie consent and PWA install prompt brand detection working correctly. Cross-module tips dismissal fix verified. Product tour user-scoped key working.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL BRAND LEAKAGE: Uses --color-brand-cyan (GymAxis #19CDFF) instead of --pulse-primary (#66ccff) for 79 elements including LOG IN button, Log new fault button, checkmarks, badges, and accent colors
ui_bugs.details: The LOG IN button class uses '!bg-[var(--color-brand-cyan)]' which resolves to GymAxis cyan. Should use --pulse-primary for Pulse Fitness branding.

action_items: CRITICAL: Replace all 79 occurrences of --color-brand-cyan with --pulse-primary in /app/frontend/src/pages/PulseLandingPage.js
Replace --color-brand-cyan-deep with appropriate Pulse color in PulseLandingPage.js
critical_code_review_comments: PulseLandingPage.js line 323-324: LOG IN button uses !bg-[var(--color-brand-cyan)] - should be --pulse-primary
PulseLandingPage.js has 79 brand-cyan usages and 0 pulse-primary usages - entire file needs brand color audit
context_for_next_testing_agent: PulseLandingPage.js brand leakage is the main issue. All other 215bw fixes (PWA branding, cookie consent, cross-module tips, product tour) are working correctly.

cookie_consent_brand_color.details: GymAxis root (/) uses rgb(37, 99, 235) = #2563EB (brand-blue). Pulse (/pulse) uses rgb(102, 204, 255) = #66ccff (pulse-primary). CookieConsent.js detectIsPulse() working correctly.

pwa_install_prompt_branding.details: PWAInstallPrompt.js uses isPulse to show 'P' with --pulse-primary for Pulse users, 'G' with --color-info-ios for GymAxis users. Verified in code lines 15-19.

cross_module_tips_dismissal.details: cross_module_tips.py line 239 now loads dismissed_ids for ALL users including master admins. API test confirmed dismiss action persists.

product_tour_user_scoped.details: ProductTour.js userScopedKey() creates per-user tour keys. Tour fires on first login, completion saved to localStorage with user-specific key.

gymaxis_master_admin_dashboard.details: Master admin dashboard loads correctly with GymAxis branding. All modules accessible: Operations Portal, CRM, Memberships, Marketing, MoD.

gymaxis_operator_dashboard.details: Operator dashboard (/dashboard?as=operator) loads with all tabs: Dashboard, Equipment, Faults, Check Sheets, Reports, Gym Layout, Documents, Suppliers, Weekly Digest.

pulse_landing_page_brand_leakage.details: CRITICAL: PulseLandingPage.js uses GymAxis cyan (#19CDFF) for LOG IN button and 78 other elements instead of Pulse blue (#66ccff). Button class: '!bg-[var(--color-brand-cyan)]'
